title: fieldwork::lemmy_api — Lemmy Client API route handlers
description: Implement Lemmy API endpoints. Key endpoints: /api/v3/community (CRUD), /api/v3/post (create/list/vote), /api/v3/comment (create/list/vote), /api/v3/user, /api/v3/site. Different from Mastodon — uses community-scoped post listing, vote counts, and threaded comment trees. Reusable by all three servers.
close_reason: Community mode complete. communities_db (28 functions, 33 tests, hot sort), AP Group actors, Lemmy API v3 (12 endpoints) in all 3 servers.
